purpose: Define the first real adapter execution contract for deterministic Git fact capture beyond the current minimal projection emitter.

notes: gix is not treated as a pure Python script dependency.
The runtime contract assumes a build/install step distinct from projection authoring.

invocation_modes: uv-managed ephemeral runtime if the build surface is exposed into Python
output_invariants: HEAD and branch/ref state are explicit
diff output names the comparison ref
output shape is deterministic for unchanged Git state

required_checks: runtime availability is explicit in the realization report
diff_state emission succeeds against an explicit comparison ref
deterministic replay on unchanged state produces identical outputs

allowed_now: report fields that distinguish minimal from real execution
not_yet_allowed: claiming real gix integration complete without a built runtime
hiding build/runtime failures behind minimal emitters
